rules.statement: UX change flow is DESIGN → PO REVIEW → REVISE → PO APPROVAL → IMPLEMENT → TEST → VISUAL VALIDATION → CLOSED.
Mockup omission is not functionality removal.
Canonical bottom navigation is Vandaag | Trainen | Inzicht | Coach | Samen; Profiel is opened via avatar.
Normal user-visible screen transitions use go() or an explicitly approved equivalent.
Visible Back and Android Back return to the same logical parent/context unless explicitly documented.
Active Training execution state may never be lost by navigation.
UNKNOWN must never be represented as zero or GREEN.
UI never calculates metrics itself; it consumes canonical Calculation → Context → Decision → Evidence/Data Quality/Confidence output.
At most one clear primary CTA per local context.
AI Coach uses abstract sparkle/star identity, explicit AI label, no robot mascot and no human avatar.
Central contracts required for loading, empty, partial, error, offline, syncing, stale, permission denied and connection required.
Primary button color conflicts: approved Design System v1 says teal; Handbook H7 says navy in light mode.
